name: What is the difference between quartz and granite countertops?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between quartz and granite countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quartz offers consistent patterns and non-porous durability without requiring routine sealing. Granite is natural stone, offering unique veining and high heat tolerance, though it requires periodic sealing to prevent stains. For busy households that prefer minimal upkeep, quartz avoids moisture absorption around sinks. If you prefer natural movement and placing hot pans briefly nearby, granite is a classic alternative. Both materials carry substantial weight, requiring verified, sturdy base cabinet support.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quartz is non-porous, highly stain-resistant, and never needs sealing. Granite is a natural stone with unique veining that handles heat well but requires periodic sealing.
